calls.title: dmTECH x GrowthBook // Evaluation Sync
calls.summary: The meeting reviewed the progress on GrowthBook's technical implementation, which is 80% complete, with data migration to BigQuery ongoing and expected to finalize in three days. The team introduced a major 5AA test, starting on June 22, with results anticipated by the end of June for evaluation on July 6. User access strategies were discussed, including providing read-only access for up to 2000 users without inflating seat counts. Effective training options are being considered, blending hands-on workshops with self-learning to ensure user proficiency in GrowthBook's features. Lastly, the team noted current user challenges with SQL-heavy reports and sharing results, underlining the need for more intuitive analytics.
calls.keywords: BigQuery, Feature Flags, A/B Testing, Seat Licensing, Trial Extension, Onboarding Training
calls.action_items:
**Jannick Weichert**
Present GrowthBook UI and A/B test results to stakeholders on or before the July 6 meeting to support decision making (24:52)
Finalize legal review of the GrowthBook master agreement prior to the July 6 meeting to avoid delays in contract signing (26:12)
Coordinate with GrowthBook team to ensure trial extension is granted through at least July 6-7 for full demo and stakeholder evaluation (27:42)
Develop an internal plan for integrating seat licensing and sharing strategy within dmTECH organization considering large user base and read-only access needs (12:16)
Collaborate internally to decide on training and onboarding formats for GrowthBook users, balancing hands-on workshops and AI-driven self-learning (29:29)

**Christian Liebenow**
Extend dmTECH trial period for GrowthBook until at least July 7 to allow full evaluation and demos (28:19)
Discuss organizational access and seat licensing strategy with CTO Jeremy and sales lead Ryan; share relevant large customer case studies to inform dmTECH (15:50)
Prepare slides and meeting plan for the July 6 management and architect call to discuss long-term commitment and ecosystem integration (33:26)
Provide onboarding and training format options to dmTECH based on their feedback, including virtual training, workshops, and AI support (31:51)
Schedule and hold a follow-up session with Jannick Weichert on July 4 at 4 PM to prepare for upcoming stakeholder calls and GrowthBook leadership discussions (34:05)

**Logan**
Support Christian Liebenow in preparing workflows and demonstrating API improvements for upcoming meetings to highlight platform flexibility and stability (27:17)
Notify GrowthBook team about feedback on API and platform stability to encourage ongoing improvements and address any issues (27:25)

**Dorit Wanner**
Review and explore GrowthBook AI agent capabilities to ease result analysis workload and improve report accessibility (23:42)
